reviews.author: Jesselyn G.
reviews.text: This is a beautiful campground, especially for being so near populated areas. The bathrooms are clean, warm, smell nice and there are also private showers. The campsites were well maintained and perfectly raked when we arrived.

reviews.author: Emily G.
reviews.text:
TIP: If you have a (normal-size Class B) campervan like a Ford Transit/Sprinter, and you find an available spot along the river in the A loop, it is indeed OK to camp there even though it's marked as a hiker/biker loop. The website says that the loop road is narrow, but vans are fine. (I emailed them to confirm that it was OK, and they replied that it was.) IMO, during high season it would be nice to reserve those spots for hikers/bikers, but we were there in late September so we felt OK about it. The A loop has flush toilets, sinks, and a trash can, but no lighting or other amenities.

We spent two nights in this campground on our way from Washington to Nevada and back. One night was on Loop B (25) and the second night was at a riverside spot on Loop A (87). Neither site had any privacy to speak of, but the setting was lovely, the sites were clean and relatively spacious, and the services were excellent. Flush toilets, electricity, even large outdoor sink areas to wash dishes (on Loop B). Cell coverage was minimal to non-existent but we were OK with that. We explored the day use area across the road and along the river, and had a really pleasant experience. You would never know that you're only a few minutes from Bend. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Orlando M.
reviews.text:
Tumalo State Park is hands down one of the best camping spots out there. The bathrooms are super clean, with great showers and toilets – a big plus when you’re camping. If you’re staying overnight, the yurts or cabins are definitely the way to go for comfort and convenience.

The Deschutes River runs right through the park, and it’s perfect for floating on tubes or rafts during the summer. We even saw plenty of wildlife, including adorable rabbits hopping around – five-star entertainment!

Another big bonus: Costco is only about 3 miles away, and you’re just 15 minutes from Old Bend. Easy access to everything you might need while still feeling like you’re out in nature. Absolutely my top pick for camping

reviews.author: Chris E.
reviews.text: While planning a trip from Northern California to Washington, we found Tumalo State Park Campground, in Tumalo Oregon. We were able to book a Yurt for one night. So, we did. This was our first time visiting Tumalo State Park and the campground. Booking was accomplished on line, with Reserve America. Check in was super easy, as I was sent an email with a code for a lock box, which had the key to the Yurt. The Yurt was clean and had a twin over full bunk, a futon, a coffee table and a table with two chairs. Electricity and electric heat, along with a ceiling fan. Also, an air purifier/fan. The Yurt was clean and neat. Bring your own bedding. Nothing but mattresses on the bunks and futon. Water was nearby, along with modern, clean restrooms and showers. However, my wife found the locks for the stall doors in the women's restroom were in need of maintenance. Across the street from the campground is the day use/picnic area, along the Deschutes river. What a great place. Overall, a nice place to camp and visit. In my opinion, the day use area was great. The campground was okay. The sites were too close for my liking. Not a lot of privacy or feeling of being away. Everyone was respectful, which makes for a good camping experience when in close proximity to other campers. That was my experience. Pictures are of the day use area.

reviews.author: Marney T.
reviews.text: This is the nicest state park campground we have ever stayed in. Nice location, close to town. We enjoyed Tumalo, fun food trucks. Great cider at Tumalo cider.  The grounds are meticulously maintained. All amenities function properly, showers, bathroom, faucets, etc. We look forward to the next visit.

reviews.author: Just us and the dogs
reviews.text: Not only is this campground in a great area, it is great in and of itself. The campground is super clean and the volunteers and staff are on top of it! They are all hardworking and it shows! We were in a FHU site in loop C. Our campsite was large enough and backed up to a hill. We had no road noise but some of the sites in loops A and B are closer to roads would have some road noise. We always had cell service with Verizon, but could not stream. However, we have a TMobile hotspot and with that we were able to stream.
reviews.title: Great Campground!
reviews.textNote: Campendium 索引快照；6晚，$51/晚；Verizon 4G 有信号但无法流媒体，T-Mobile 热点可流媒体；星级为情感映射（页面未在快照中暴露单条星级）

reviews.text: Very clean & quiet campground in one of the most scenic areas. Plenty to do within an hour drive. Out of state rate, not bad for FHU. If we're ever back near Bend, this is where we'd stay.
reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.textNote: Campendium 索引快照；5晚，$46/晚；快照未显示作者名，留空未猜；星级为情感映射

reviews.author: Dick Tony
reviews.text: I'm not quite in agreement with all of the love that I see the other reviewers have for Tumalo State Park. It is the best option if you're looking for convenience to Bend without being stuck in an RV Park in town, of which there is only one (with another set to open this summer). But the State Park and campground were just fine, not extraordinary. Showers were clean, sites were close together, and campground hosts were unusually friendly and helpful.
reviews.title: Convenient to Bend, but otherwise just OK.

reviews.text: What a great campground! Super close to Bend, very clean, and friendly rangers and camp hosts. I arrived a day early and was able to grab a spot— the camp host let me know that the spot (C72) is often not listed online but kept aside as an "emergency" campground for drop ins. It is a really great spot with a lot of space and more priva

reviews.author: Annabell O
reviews.text: We chose this campground for its proximity to Bend, and really enjoyed our quick stay here. Our site was right next to the river, and while there wasn't much privacy on one side, the other side was all greenery. The bathroom was small, but adequate. We would definitely stay here again if we're in the area!
reviews.title: Nice campground near Bend
reviews.textNote: 页面显示 Reviewed July 24, 2021 / Written July 25, 2021，采用 Written 日期；星级为情感映射（正面但有小瑕疵→4）

reviews.author: sherbog G
reviews.text: I have never been disappointed in an Oregon State Park and Tumalo is no exception. This state park exceeded my expectations. I love to hike and this park has the trails to make my experience memorable for all the right reasons. Tumalo Stat3 Park- I stayed at a tent site. RV and Tent sites are large and some offer a great deal of privacy. Tent site for two nights plus reservation fee of $8 came to $50. Tumalo has no dump site. Clean bathrooms and showers. Cell service was one or two bars depending on location in the park. Spotless bath/shower rooms and hot water in for hand washing in the sinks. Great playground for the children.
reviews.textNote: Springfield, Oregon；帐篷营位2晚+$8预订费共$50；星级为情感映射

reviews.author: Becky P
reviews.text: This is an absolutely lovely state park located in the city of Bend, and a great place to spend the day hiking! It was only $5 to park for the day which I thought was very reasonable! I spent about two hours at this park, but you could easily spend the whole day! I choose one hike, the Canyon Loop Trail. I'd say it was a moderate level hike, and very scenic along the river, tall rocks and forest. I saw an otter and many small birds. It was not too crowded on the Saturday I visited. There is very helpful signage along the trail so you do not get lost. It was chilly but sunny and a perfect day to hike.
reviews.title: A wonderful park to hike
reviews.textNote: Tacoma, Washington；day use 徒步评价（未过夜露营），Canyon Loop Trail，看见水獭；星级为情感映射

reviews.author: Doug W
reviews.text: We stayed at the park for 4 nights this June. Had a great spot on the outside of the ring with full hook ups. Washrooms have recently been redone and for a state park and very good. Park staff were friendly and always ready to assist. Good location close to Bend but quiet at night.
reviews.title: great camping close to town
reviews.textNote: Sidney, Canada；2016年6月住4晚；星级为情感映射

reviews.author: richardrN4453MY
reviews.text: So, yes this is a typical state park camping situation. The sites are close but well maintained. The bathrooms and shower are cleaner than many and it's crowded with families and their dogs. It is conveniently located to Bend and the surrounding outdoors snagged a last minute site 2 days before a Father's Day Sunday but the campground did fill to capacity. If you like to tent camp try and find somewhere less crowded, but it does serve the purpose and is what is expected.
reviews.title: great camping close to town
reviews.textNote: 经手机发布；星级为情感映射（褒贬参半→3）

reviews.author: KarenD940
reviews.text: Wow, Oregon has top notch campgrounds. Free showers (and yes with hot water). This place is great because it is so close to Bend,so there is lots to do and great places to eat and drink.
reviews.textNote: Seattle；经手机发布；星级为情感映射

reviews.author: SRockGibson
reviews.text: We have stayed at Tumalo at least a dozen times. It is in a great location. They day use area is beautiful, right on the banks of the Deschutes River. The campground is very well maintained; hookups always work. I think it's the only campground that we've stayed at that has "solar showers." Very environmentally friendly, free and they work too!
reviews.textNote: San Ramon；住过至少十几次的老客；提到太阳能淋浴；星级为情感映射

reviews.author: monette m
reviews.text: I was here briefly with a group to paint. Nice location and facilities for campers. Very clean area with the river flowing through it. The famiilies with kids apparered to be having a great time jumping in and out of the refreshingly cool river. Looked to be a very nice place for a family to relax. Quiet spot for paining, as well.
reviews.textNote: Washington DC；写生团体短暂停留；拼写错误为原文所有（famiilies/apparered/paining）；星级为情感映射

reviews.author: Andrew C
reviews.text: If you're looking for a long rest stop or a picnic close to town, this little gem has it all - lots of grass and shady areas, public grills and picnic tables, a few easy trails, and access to a fairly calm portion of the Deschutes River. Added bonuses include clean, spacious bathroom areas and plenty of campsites, with a few yurts to choose from as well (just make sure you make reservations in summer high season - the place gets regularly filled up). The entire area is pretty well-laid out and offers good access to either Bend or Sisters, or high desert areas to the east. I've stopped here a few times, usually for a picnic or to stretch my legs and walk the dog, but never camped - though I've heard nothing but good reviews from friends. $5 day use fee unless you have a pass.
reviews.title: Great hike close to town
reviews.textNote: Portland, Oregon；day use/野餐评价，作者自述从未过夜露营；星级为情感映射

reviews.author: Pattym51
reviews.text: I have lived in Bend for 35 Years. Tumalo State Park is literally 3 minutes form my house. I have not gone in recent years as it has become quite the tourist attraction. Just recently a friend told me about the trail at the end of the parking lot. OMG it is Fabulous! It follows the Deschutes and is just so beautiful. It is about 3.5 miles round trip. When you get to the end if you have a pet or bicycle you must turn around as it connects to the new Riley Nature Preserve and no pets or Bicycles are permitted.It is not a difficult hike so if you are looking for a challenge go elsewhere. This has been my new favorite place to take my dog for a walk. In October and through now (January) there is no one there and lack of snow this year makes it doable. Once it snows it won't be happening. Note--if you go there enjoy the beauty .It is amazing
reviews.textNote: Bend 本地人（住35年）；徒步小径评价（3.5英里往返，连接 Riley Nature Preserve，该段禁宠物/自行车）；拼写错误为原文所有（form/no one there）；星级为情感映射
